base_prompt:
GAME TITLE LOGO, wide landscape (about 3:1), transparent background (real alpha channel), no other text, no watermark, nothing cropped, centered with a little padding.
The logo must spell EXACTLY this text, character for character, in English: Coal-or-Gift   (C-o-a-l, hyphen, o-r, hyphen, G-i-f-t; keep both hyphens; one single line). Check the spelling carefully.
STYLE (very important, the previous version was too 3D and hard to read): perfectly FLAT 2D vector sticker lettering. ONLY flat solid color fills. NO gradients, NO glossy highlights, NO shine, NO bevel, NO inner shadows, NO texture, NO snow caps, NO sparkles, NO small decorations on or around the letters. Chunky rounded bold sans-serif letters with generous spacing between letters so every letter is crisp and instantly readable even at a very small size. High contrast between the letters and their outline.

jobs.name: flat_a
jobs.prompt: Colors: 'Coal' in solid dark charcoal (#2b2b33) letters with three small flat orange ember dots inside the letters; '-or-' in smaller solid white letters; 'Gift' in solid bright red (#e8283c) letters with one flat gold ribbon cross band on the letters. Every letter has a thin dark navy outline, and the WHOLE logo is surrounded by one thick solid WHITE sticker border (like a die-cut sticker), so it stays readable on any busy background.

jobs.name: flat_b
jobs.prompt: Colors: 'Coal' in solid dark charcoal letters, '-or-' in solid gold-yellow, 'Gift' in solid bright red letters. A hard-edged offset shadow in dark navy under every letter (no blur), a thick dark navy outline around each letter, and one thick solid WHITE outer border around the whole logo for contrast.

jobs.name: flat_c
jobs.prompt: Colors: the logo sits on a flat rounded-rectangle badge plate in solid dark navy (#1a1030) with a thick solid white border and no other decoration. On the plate: 'Coal' in solid orange-yellow letters, '-or-' in solid white, 'Gift' in solid bright red letters with a thin white outline so the red reads on the dark plate. Everything flat.
